description: This is a Java JUnit test class for the LoanItemReader component in the Apache Fineract project, focusing on testing loan retrieval and locking mechanisms during COB (Close Of Business) processing.

classes.name: LoanItemReaderTest
classes.description: Test class for the LoanItemReader component, verifying loan retrieval and locking logic within the COB process.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets thread-local context after each test.

methods.name: testLoanItemReaderSimple
methods.description: Tests the basic reading of multiple loans, verifying that each loan is retrieved once and correctly.

methods.name: testLoanItemReadNoOpenLoansFound
methods.description: Verifies the behavior when no open loans are found; expects null result.

methods.name: testLoanItemReaderMultiThreadRead
methods.description: Tests concurrent reading of loans across multiple threads, confirming thread safety and correct retrieval.
